verification_axes.meaning: Signature integrity/key provenance plus explicit claim validation; cached verification can outlive session revocation
does_not_prove: Active writable session or atomic write authorization

verification_axes.meaning: Configured trusted Auth server accepts the exact bearer and returns user identity; may report server session errors depending deployed behavior
does_not_prove: Race-free active session at later DB commit

verification_axes.meaning: Separate authoritative session/user/deadline/revocation and transaction-race contract
does_not_prove: Owner authorization to deploy SQL/grants or register writes

requirements.title: Token provenance
requirements.requirement: Use exact request-local bearer already extracted by existing guard, never mutable client session state, body identity, user_metadata or decoded-only JWT. Explicit token argument to both owner-configured verification operations; no omitted token/getSession fallback.

requirements.title: Trusted verification channel
requirements.requirement: Future live client must reuse existing Auth service configuration/architecture and trusted project endpoint. No token-derived issuer/JWKS URL, client-supplied keys, service-role author path, allowExpired override, or caller verification bypass. No real client authorized here.

requirements.title: Subject/session/expiry evidence
requirements.requirement: Require successful complete getUser user.id and verified getClaims sub/session_id/exp for same token. Normalize/compare user.id==sub; validate UUIDs, finite safe integral NumericDate conversion and expiry after async work. Current mock bridge only composes assertions, not signatures.

requirements.title: Policy before projection
requirements.requirement: Explicit trusted issuer/audiences and acceptable token role/algorithm/anonymous/AAL/time policy are owner decisions. Validate required policy before bridge drops issuer/aud/nbf/header fields; no implicit defaults or policy derived from token. Reject missing policy, wrong project/audience/service credentials and malformed claims.

requirements.title: Clock and scope
requirements.requirement: Preserve per-request immutable token/author/session/expiry binding, response-arrival snapshots and conservative start-time freshness. Recheck after awaits, expiry/stale/future proof, nbf/iat per explicitly approved policy; retain current30000ms bound without silently relaxing it.

requirements.title: SDK path accountability
requirements.requirement: Record whether evidence used local asymmetric signature or Auth-server fallback. getClaims may perform network/key lookup; no assumed offline success. Signing mode/key rotation/cache trust remain unobserved. Successful method result alone does not prove application issuer/audience policy or session status.

requirements.title: Independent session authority
requirements.requirement: Active/revoked state is separate: authoritative matching session+user, expiry/inactivity/not_after semantics and failure-closed policy require catalog/provider acceptance. SDK may surface server SessionMissing errors, but no target behavior is inferred and successful getUser is not atomic session/write authorization.

requirements.title: Atomic protected write boundary
requirements.requirement: For future writes, session/revocation check must have reviewed race/linearization semantics with book ownership in same protected transaction (session then book lock candidate). No auth.sessions UPDATE/grant/helper deployment approved; registry alternative also needs owner review. Auth calls outside a DB transaction leave a TOCTOU gap.

requirements.title: Error and privacy contract
requirements.requirement: Reject Auth errors, absent/partial/contradictory proof and disallowed policy. Distinguish invalid evidence from provider/configuration/timeouts internally; external response mapping is TRANSPORT decision. No sensitive token/claims/user/manuscript logs or cached foreign receipts. No fail-open offline fallback when required Auth verification unavailable.

requirements.title: Reuse architecture and durable safety
requirements.requirement: Existing verify(token)->{id}, AuthGuard and Book routes remain unchanged. Future additive service method plus unregistered request-bound provider may reuse publicClient; no replacement Auth stack. Do not make current stateful WorkspaceService request-scoped and lose pending maps without a reviewed durable operation/outbox contract. Module/routes/writes remain separately gated.

owner_choices.proposal: Proposed reuse getUser(explicitToken)+getClaims(sameToken) for principal evidence, after policy checks. Alternative verified-claims-only cannot satisfy currently required Auth-server user check without new owner decision. Possible duplicate getUser fallback cost remains unverified.
